During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] enacted a '''bombardment''' of the politically-influential [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mindabaal]]. The planet was left in ruins with only a few survivors. The royal palace was annihilated, and the fate of the royal family was unknown, although the [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] [[Jericho Donovan|Jericho]] and [[Josephine Donovan]] held out hope that their father was still alive.
